;; Cloudflare-style export with the documented originless placeholders (192.0.2.0 and 100::,
;; a proxied record served by a Worker or a redirect rule, no origin server) and a proxied

;; SOA Record
example.com	3600	IN	SOA	ada.ns.cloudflare.com. dns.cloudflare.com. 2051234568 10000 2400 604800 3600

;; NS Records
example.com.	86400	IN	NS	ada.ns.cloudflare.com.
example.com.	86400	IN	NS	bob.ns.cloudflare.com.

;; A Records
example.com.	1	IN	A	192.0.2.10 ; cf_tags=cf-proxied:true
worker.example.com.	1	IN	A	192.0.2.0 ; Worker route, no origin server cf_tags=cf-proxied:true
cfip.example.com.	1	IN	A	104.16.1.1 ; points at a Cloudflare address cf_tags=cf-proxied:true

;; AAAA Records
edge.example.com.	1	IN	AAAA	100:: ; redirect rule only cf_tags=cf-proxied:true
